Subject: Discrepancy in PO 987321 allocation

Hi Vanessa,

We're reconciling our month-end spend and noticed the PO you issued to Acme (PO 987321) has line allocations that don't match the commitments in our SOW. Attached is a ledger extract from our side showing the lines posted to SaaS Licensing (line 3) that should have been applied to Professional Services (line 2). This has pushed us over the agreed spend cap for SaaS licensing for August.

Can your team confirm the source of the allocation and whether a corrective line-item remap is possible? We need to finalize our internal month-end before Friday and would appreciate a plan and an ETA.

Attachments:
- po-987321-ledger-extract.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Thanks,
Lisa Hart
Director, Vendor Finance | Acme Corp

- Ben to verify original PO creation metadata and the line-item codes used. (ETA today EOD)
- If mismatch is confirmed, propose a corrective line swap and delta credit to Acme for any overage. We’ll provide formal instructions and a remediation file you can apply to your ledger. (ETA tomorrow)
- Marissa to confirm spend-cap impact and approve any temporary spend-cap adjustment if needed for the month close.

Would a 10:30am PST quick call today work to align on scope? If not, we’ll proceed asynchronously and share a remediation plan.

Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in PO 987321 allocation — proposed fix

Vanessa / Lisa — I dug into the PO creation logs. Summary:
- PO 987321 was created on 2026-08-02 with three line items: line1 (Platform credits), line2 (Professional Services), line3 (SaaS Licensing).
- During the export to the billing feed we inadvertently applied the taxonomy tag 'SAAS-LICENSE' to two quantity rows: one that should have been 'PRO-SERV' (line2). The underlying amounts are correct, the labels used in the feed are the problem.

Proposed remediation (technical + finance):
1) Line remap file — we will produce a corrected line-item CSV that switches the taxonomy for the affected row(s). The file will include original_line_id, corrected_line_code, amount. (attached: po-987321-lineitem-change.xlsx)
2) Temporary spend-cap waiver — Marissa, please approve a one-time spend-cap buffer of $8,500 on Acme's SaaS licensing for August to avoid automated holds while the remap is applied.
3) Credit note if any true overcharge is discovered after the remap.

If you want, we can apply the remap on our end and emit a corrected invoice feed; otherwise we can send the remap file for Acme to ingest. Preference?

Attachments:
- po-987321-lineitem-change.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Lisa / Ben / Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick triage. Finance reviewed Ben's findings and approved the temporary spend-cap buffer. Final plan below (agreed):

1) Redwood will apply the remap on our billing feed Friday 09/24 02:00 AM UTC. This will update the taxonomy labels so the amounts map to Professional Services instead of SaaS Licensing.
2) Acme will receive a corrected invoice feed and a short remediation pack (redwood-correction-plan-v1.pdf) documenting the change.
3) Redwood will issue a credit note if after remap there's a measurable overcharge; initial analysis suggests none but we'll reconcile within 7 business days.
4) Preventive action: Ben will add a validation rule in the feed transformer to block taxonomy labels that don't align to the PO's line schema. ETA for rule rollout: 2 weeks.

Action items / owners:
- Ben: apply remap and produce corrected feed (owner, done by 2026-09-24)
- Vanessa: confirm scheduling and update Acme exec sponsor (owner, in progress)
- Marissa: apply spend-cap buffer and confirm back to Lisa when done (owner, done)
- Lisa: confirm receipt and let us know if your ledger reconciles after the feed (owner, pending)

Attachments included: po-987321-lineitem-change.xlsx, redwood-correction-plan-v1.pdf

Thanks again for the patience — we'll follow up with the remediation pack once the feed goes live.

Regards,
